title: Petrol, diesel prices in your city today — 14 March: Fuel rates in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi amid Middle East conflict | Today News
summary: Indian fuel prices stable amid Middle East conflict, with state-level tax differences causing price variations across cities. Oil companies absorb volatility to avoid consumer price shocks, incurring losses due to global crude price increases and currency exchange rates.
sentiment_reason: The stability in fuel prices and the absorption of volatility by oil companies to prevent consumer price shocks and inflation concerns reflect a negative market impact due to geopolitical tensions and their effect on crude oil prices and the forex stockpile.
